<syntaxhighlight lang="vbnet">Sub showBoard(board() As Integer, w As Integer, nq As Integer)
    Dim black As Integer = 0
    For i As Integer = 0 To w*w - 1
        Dim p1 As String = Iif(i Mod w <> 0, "", Chr(10) & "    ")
        
        Dim p2 As String
        If board(i) < 0 Then
            p2 = "W "
        Else
            If board(i) = 0 And black < nq Then
                p2 = "B "
            Elseif ((i \ w) Xor (i Mod w)) Mod 2 <> 0 Then
                p2 = "o "
            Else
                p2 = ". "
            End If
            If board(i) = 0 Then black += 1
        End If
        
        Print p1 & p2;
    Next
    Print Chr(10)
End Sub

Function placeQueen(attackTable() As Integer, board() As Integer, _
    w As Integer, nq As Integer, depth As Integer, _
    posic As Integer, available As Integer) As Integer
    
    If depth = nq Then Return True
    
    For p As Integer = posic To w*w - 1
        Dim ix As Integer = p * w * 4
        Dim attacked As Integer = 0
        Dim i As Integer = 0
        
        While attackTable(ix + i) >= 0
            Dim v As Integer = attackTable(ix + i)
            Dim vv As Integer = board(v)
            If vv >= 0 Then
                If vv = 0 Then attacked += 1
                board(v) += 1
            End If
            i += 1
        Wend
        
        If available - attacked >= nq Then
            board(p) = -board(p) - 1
            Dim aa As Integer = available - attacked
            
            If placeQueen(attackTable(), board(), w, nq, depth + 1, p + 1, aa) Then
                Return True
            End If
            
            board(p) = -board(p) - 1
        End If
        
        i = 0
        While attackTable(ix + i) >= 0
            Dim v As Integer = attackTable(ix + i)
            If board(v) > 0 Then board(v) -= 1
            i += 1
        Wend
    Next
    
    Return False
End Function

Function makeBoard(w As Integer, nq As Integer) As Integer
    Print "Size " & w & " board, " & nq & " queens:";
    
    Dim attackTable(0 To w*w*w*4 - 1) As Integer
    Dim board(0 To w*w - 1) As Integer
    
    For p As Integer = 0 To w*w - 1
        Dim row As Integer = p \ w
        Dim col As Integer = p Mod w
        Dim ix As Integer = p * 4 * w
        
        attackTable(ix) = p
        ix += 1
        
        Dim r(0 To 2) As Integer = {-1, 0, 1}
        
        For di As Integer = 0 To 2
            For dj As Integer = 0 To 2
                If r(di) = 0 And r(dj) = 0 Then Continue For
                
                Dim l As Integer = 1
                Do
                    Dim i As Integer = row + l * r(di)
                    Dim j As Integer = col + l * r(dj)
                    If i < 0 Or i >= w Or j < 0 Or j >= w Then Exit Do
                    
                    attackTable(ix) = i*w + j
                    ix += 1
                    l += 1
                Loop
            Next
        Next
        
        attackTable(ix) = -1
        ix += 1
    Next
    
    Dim found As Integer = placeQueen(attackTable(), board(), w, nq, 0, 0, w*w)
    
    If found Then
        Print
        showBoard(board(), w, nq)
    Else
        Print !" No solution.\n"
    End If
    
    Return found
End Function


'Task requirement
makeBoard(5, 4)
makeBoard(8, 9)
'Stretch task
makeBoard(8,10)
makeBoard(9, 9)
makeBoard(9, 12)
makeBoard(9, 13)

Sleep</syntaxhighlight>
